enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to shoulders. Adjust pillow under head. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain still. Turn to back. Pull blanket down. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Lie still.

Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Turn off tap. Dry face. Turn off light. Turn off water heater. Walk out.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Close cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Eat cereal. Drink milk from bowl. Place spoon in bowl. Pick up bowl. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in dishwasher. Wash hands. Dry hands. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close closet. Lay clothes on bed. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Brush hair. Pick up bag. Check contents. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Swipe card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter office building.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open email. Read email. Type reply. Send email. Pick up phone. Dial number. Make phone call. Hang up. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Print document. Walk to printer. Pick up document. Return to desk.
Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Clear tray. Walk outside. Walk back to office.

Sit at desk. Open email. Read email. Type reply. Send email. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Print document. Walk to printer. Pick up document. Return to desk. Attend meeting. Sit in chair. Take notes. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Make phone call. Hang up.
Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Swipe card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to house. Enter house.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Close cabinet. Turn on induction cooker. Cut vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Stir with spoon. Turn off induction cooker. Take out plate. Scoop food onto plate. Pick up plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water.

Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with sponge. Rinse sponge. Wipe table. Sweep floor. Empty trash. Take out trash. Return. Turn off kitchen light.

Walk into living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Return to couch. Sit down. Drink. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk into bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open browser. Check email. Open social media. Type message. Send message. Open document. Type document. Save document. Close browser. Turn off computer. Close laptop. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Turn off tap. Dry face. Turn off light. Turn off water heater. Walk out.

Walk into bedroom. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Remain still. Breathe. Turn to back. Pull blanket down. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Lie still.
